summary: Nez Perce NF L-4 cab on a log base, c.1933; firelookout.com says abandoned 1950; Forest Service says burned September 1963; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Burned in September 1963 per the Forest Service; firelookout.com gives abandonment in 1950, which the other sources do not confirm

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives abandonment in 1950. The Weebly page describes disuse because of the limited view under a September 1963 entry, and the Forest Service gives no year before the burning. The story reports both and does not pick a year for the end of use.

sources.title: Falls Point Lookout (Facebook post, September 16, 2021)
sources.publisher: U.S. Forest Service, Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests

notes_for_editor: Build year 1933 and the 1963 burning agree across all four sources. The 1950 abandonment comes only from firelookout.com. No source describes the site today or current road access. Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site 'Drive-Up' and 'Burned Down' without explanation, so the story quotes the tags (final paragraph, footnote 2) and does not read them as a current access statement. The access block is omitted. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, and no other source names staff. No photos added: the Forest Service Facebook post carries three photo captions (1939, 1950s, September 1963), but I did not have their image URLs. The brief's events list had no entries for this lookout; these are new. The brief's kind 'two_story' is not checked here.
